decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted 16th February 2015 and numbered 124/Cra/1 and 3, and Site Plan 1, and 8th April 2015 and numbered 124/Cra/2 and Block Plan 1 therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.
Condition : 4 - The outbuilding hereby permitted shall not be occupied at any time other than for purposes incidental to the residential use of the dwelling known as 124 Cranford Lane.

Condition : 5 - The proposed development shall include the implementation of 2.4 metre by 2.4 metre pedestrian visibility splays either side of the crossover and nothing over the height of 600 millimetres shall be installed within this area.
description: Erection of a single rear storey extension. Erection of a single storey outbuilding in rear garden for use as gym and formation of vehicle access to front.
